findings.description: The person walking away in the background is initially carrying a large red accessory in their left hand. As they move onto the flat path, the accessory vanishes entirely from their hands without being dropped.
The background person transitions from being midway down the stairs to several feet away on the flat pavement in a fraction of a second, resulting in a sudden, impossible jump in position.
